Hi Sophie / NovaStack procurement team —

Quick note following our renewal discussion last week. NovaStack is planning a Q1 capacity uplift (approx +40% peak tokens) and would like to accelerate the term renewal to lock preferred pricing. Before we can finalize the term amendment and commit, procurement asked for our standard vendor accreditation and a proposed PO cadence that fits your finance cycles.

What I’ve attached: redwood_renewal_summary_Q1_topup.xlsx (high-level uplift math + proposed staggered PO plan).

Proposed handshake:
- We send SOC2 + attestation and onboarding checklist this week.
- NovaStack confirms whether staged PO (3 monthly POs) works for finance or if a single PO is required.
- If staged is OK, we’ll prepare a short amendment (no change to SLAs) and route via DocuSign.

Can you confirm the two procurement items above and any additional vendor evidence you need (ISO, data residency, KMS)? If helpful I can loop in Legal/Finance on our side for a quick call — available Wed/Thu afternoon.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the summary. Procurement has two immediate asks before we can move to PO stage:
1) Formal SOC2 report + recent attestation (we need the full report rather than a summary).
2) A clear PO cadence and billing schedule. Our finance team prefers a single PO for the quarter but will accept staged POs if there is a clear invoicing timetable and an approval from Finance Director (Tom).

Also: please include the standard onboarding checklist and a named point of contact for escalation during provisioning.

Can you upload the SOC2 report to the shared Drive link and confirm whether the staged PO schedule in your workbook maps to monthly invoices? If so, please provide the proposed invoice dates.
